title: Playboy July 2006 Vida Guerra Jerry Bruckheimer Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, July 2006. Original $5.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Cover features: La Dolce Vida! Vida Guerra pictorial; Hollywood hitmaker Jerry Bruckheimer interview; UFC's Dana White 20Q; drifting and hot soccer babes; plus Margaret Atwood, Penn Jillette, Ray Kurzweil, and beach fashion with Michelle Lombardo.

Back cover: Absolut vodka ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
